tldr: "A locked writeup for people who already owned the box. Paste the user flag to read up to user.txt, or the root flag to read the whole thing. Everything past the intro is AES-encrypted in the page and decrypted in your browser with the flag as the key."

<div class="bs-wrap">



<div class="ft-gate">
  <h3>unseal</h3>
  <p class="ft-lead">Paste a flag, 32 hex chars, braces optional. User flag reveals up to user. Root flag reveals everything.</p>
  <div class="ft-row">
    <input id="bs-flag" type="text" placeholder="paste user or root flag" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    <button id="bs-go">unseal</button>
  </div>
  <div id="bs-status" class="ft-status"></div>
</div>

<div id="bs-user"></div>
<div id="bs-root"></div>
<div id="bs-lockmsg" class="ft-locked" hidden>User section unlocked. The root half stays sealed, enter the root flag to reveal it.</div>

</div>

<script type="text/plain" id="bs-ub"></script>
<script type="text/plain" id="bs-rb"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/crypto-js/4.2.0/crypto-js.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  var ub=document.getElementById('bs-ub').textContent.trim();
  var rb=document.getElementById('bs-rb').textContent.trim();
  var inp=document.getElementById('bs-flag'), btn=document.getElementById('bs-go'), st=document.getElementById('bs-status');
  function dec(blob,key){try{var w=CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(blob,key);var t=w.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);return t||null;}catch(e){return null;}}
  function go(){
    var f=(inp.value||'').trim().replace(/^flag\{/,'').replace(/^HTB\{/,'').replace(/\}$/,'');
    if(!f){st.textContent='';return;}
    var r=dec(rb,f);
    if(r&&r.indexOf('OK_ROOT::')===0){
      var m=r.match(/USERFLAG=([0-9a-f]{32})::/); var uf=m?m[1]:null;
      var rootHtml=r.replace(/^OK_ROOT::USERFLAG=[0-9a-f]{32}::/,''), uHtml='';
      if(uf){var u=dec(ub,uf); if(u&&u.indexOf('OK_USER::')===0) uHtml=u.slice(9);}
      document.getElementById('bs-user').innerHTML=uHtml;
      document.getElementById('bs-root').innerHTML=rootHtml;
      document.getElementById('bs-lockmsg').hidden=true;
      st.className='ft-ok'; st.textContent='[+] root flag accepted. full writeup unsealed.';
      window.scrollTo({top:document.getElementById('bs-user').offsetTop-40,behavior:'smooth'}); return;
    }
    var u=dec(ub,f);
    if(u&&u.indexOf('OK_USER::')===0){
      document.getElementById('bs-user').innerHTML=u.slice(9);
      document.getElementById('bs-root').innerHTML='';
      document.getElementById('bs-lockmsg').hidden=false;
      st.className='ft-ok'; st.textContent='[+] user flag accepted. root half still sealed.';
      window.scrollTo({top:document.getElementById('bs-user').offsetTop-40,behavior:'smooth'}); return;
    }
    st.className='ft-bad'; st.textContent='[-] wrong flag.';
  }
  btn.addEventListener('click',go);
  inp.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter')go();});
})();
</script>
